description: This Java source file implements a connection factory for AMQP 1.0 protocol using vertx-proton library. It manages the creation and handling of AMQP connections, including SSL/TLS configuration, connection timeout handling, and connection lifecycle management.

classes.name: ConnectionFactoryImpl
classes.description: A final class that implements the ConnectionFactory interface, providing methods to establish and manage AMQP connections using vertx-proton.

methods.name: ConnectionFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with Vertx instance and configuration properties.

methods.name: setProtonClient
methods.description: Sets an external ProtonClient instance to be used for connections.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name property from the configuration.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host property from the configuration.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port property from the configuration.

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the path separator from the configuration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates an AMQP connection with provided options and handlers, managing connection setup, timeout, and lifecycle.

methods.name: createClientOptions
methods.description: Creates and configures a default ProtonClientOptions instance with default timeout, heartbeat, and reconnect attempts.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Configures the ProtonClientOptions with TLS, SASL mechanisms based on the provided username and password.

methods.name: addTlsTrustOptions
methods.description: Configures SSL/TLS trust options and SSL Engine options based on the configuration and OpenSSL support.

methods.name: addTlsKeyCertOptions
methods.description: Adds client key and certificate options for SSL/TLS if configured.

methods.name: failConnectionAttempt
methods.description: Handles failed connection attempts by logging and invoking the connection result handler with a failure.

methods.name: handleConnectionAttemptResult
methods.description: Processes the outcome of the connection attempt, manages connection timeout, and proceeds with open/close handling.

methods.name: handleTimedOutConnectionAttemptResult
methods.description: Handles scenarios where connection attempts time out, ensuring resources are cleaned up.

methods.name: handleTimedOutOpenHandlerResult
methods.description: Handles open frame results that arrive after a connection timeout was triggered.
